description: This file defines the client-side JavaScript for managing a dynamic, draggable list with add, delete, sort, and inline editing capabilities, specifically for a dropdown list UI component within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM ModuleBuilder.

classes.name: SimpleList
classes.description: A singleton object encapsulating functions to manage a draggable, editable list interface, including adding, deleting, sorting, and inline editing of list items.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SimpleList object, setting up drag-and-drop zones, event listeners, and transaction tracking for list modifications.

methods.name: isValidDropDownKey
methods.description: Validates that a dropdown key contains only word characters, digits, spaces, or dots, or is empty.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a given list item or input value is considered blank.

methods.name: addToList
methods.description: Adds a new item to the list after validating the input and ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: sortAscending
methods.description: Sorts list items in ascending order based on their input value using a Shellsort algorithm.

methods.name: sortDescending
methods.description: Sorts list items in descending order.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Serializes the current list into JSON and triggers the save process, with confirmation if items were deleted.

methods.name: deleteDropDownValue
methods.description: Marks or unmarks a list item as deleted.

methods.name: editDropDownValue
methods.description: Enables inline editing of a list item's value.

methods.name: endCurrentDropDownEdit
methods.description: Finalizes the current inline edit, saving the new value.

methods.name: setDropDownValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a list item and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: undoDeleteDropDown
methods.description: Reverts a delete action on a list item.

methods.name: undoDropDownChange
methods.description: Reverts a change to a list item's value.

methods.name: redoDropDownChange
methods.description: Re-applies a previously reverted change to a list item's value.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last transaction.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Re-applies the last undone transaction.
